summary:
We made made a game about space mission our project is an interactive game inspired by NASA space exploration missions in this game players become a space engineers 
and we travel Earth to Mars using manage fuel and power, players must take smart decisions because every decision affect their mission.
Our main aim is to teach students about space science, problem solving and resource management through gaming
details:
our mission is to travel from Earth to Mars

in this game the player becomes a space explorer and controls a rocket using the arrow keys , we used scratch 2.0 ,The game by the rocket launching from earth during the space journey many obstacles comes the player should overcome this , the game teaches us that every decision is important for the success of a space mission.
